messages:
incident-bot: NOTICE: Partial ordering/duplication observed on realtime websockets in us-east-1. Some client sessions received out-of-order chunks. Investigating. https://status.redwood.example/incident/2240012345 :warning:

alice: saw reports from two customers around 2240011200. Repro with loadtester hitting long-lived streams, especially with intermittent proxy restarts.

ben_sre: metrics: reorder-rate peaked ~0.9% on mux-proxy cluster. No increase in 5xx. Logs show worker churn during drain windows.

netops: rolled edge-proxy v2.4.0 in staggered waves starting 2240010000 to apply TLS perf fix. Might correlate.

support: affected customers: ByteDocs, QueryFlow. Tickets created and stubbed with sample request IDs.

ben_sre: quick mitigations applied: paused further proxy restarts, increased connection drain timeout 5s->25s, enabled session-pin for existing connections.

alice: after mitigations reorder-rate down to ~0.07%. No new customer complaints in last 10m.

eva_prod: updated status page and notified impacted teams. Will send customer-facing note in 20m.

ben_sre: next steps: rollback proxy rollout in us-east to v2.3.x for safety, run a canary with patched session handling, and include rollout timing in RCA.

incident-bot: STATUS PAGE: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2240012345 Current: mitigated, monitoring.

support: action items: @ben_sre (RCA lead), @alice (trace collection), @netops (rollback schedule). Please update thread when actions complete. :white_check_mark:
